senses.gloss: (b. h.;cmp. בטט, v. Friedr. Del. Proleg. p. 98) to burst forth, to shine
to illumine. Targ. II Esth. I, 2 (in an enigma about nafta) נשפך כמים ומַבִּיט לבית it is poured out like water and illumines the house.

units: <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 76">Yalk. Gen. 76</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 15:5">Gen. XV, 5</cite>) <he>אין הַבֵּט וכ׳</he> (<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 44">Gen. R. s. 44</cite> <cite ref="E00033"><he>הַבָּטָה</he></cite> q. v.).
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 21:1">Pesik. R. s. 21</cite> [read:] <he>האיקונין הזו … מַבִּיטִים בה … בי היא מַבֶּטֶת</he> a thousand people look at a portrait, every one says, it is looking at me.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 21:1">Ib.</cite> <he>ולהַבִּיט בכל אחד ואחד וכ׳</he> and for the Lord to look at every one of the Israelites and say &c.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 21:1">Ib.</cite> <he>מה לך מביט באלו</he> why dost thou look up to those men?; a. fr.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 101b:5">Snh. 101ᵇ</cite> (play on <cite ref="N00067"><he>נבט</he></cite>) <he>שני׳ ולא ראה</he> he (Nebat) had a vision but did not see (interpret it properly); <cite ref="Sanhedrin 101b:7">ib.</cite> <he>שלשה נִבְּטוּ וכ׳</he>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 196:4">Yalk. Kings 196</cite>.
